scope: Muted Chrome browser acceptance for the buyer worksheet; figures are hypothetical software expectations, not observed customer savings.
checks: Initial task, usage, labor and setup inputs are blank; proposed prices are explicit and no savings result or export is prefilled
Blank required input fails visibly, marks the relevant field and moves keyboard focus without creating an estimate
Explicitly hypothetical example preserves the buyer-value shortfall, full pilot fee and negative first month in actual JSON export
Small positive monthly value retains a 330-month upfront payback and negative first-month result rather than implying rapid repayment
A slower tool preserves signed time and labor losses with unavailable break-even and payback
Measured label requires a substantive note, remains self-reported and unverified, and renders untrusted notes as inert text
Editing an applied input clears stale results and disables export until recalculation
Enter submits from an edited numeric field and result focus does not invalidate the newly applied export
Exact sixty-report break-even stays at sixty with zero net value and no positive payback claim
Fractional report counts and negative or excessive cost inputs fail visibly before export
Unconfirmed task equivalence prevents a time-savings estimate and focuses the declaration
Reset removes entered buyer information and results, preserves only explicit proposed prices and returns focus to the first input
Complete worksheet and eight result metrics remain available without page-level horizontal overflow at 320 pixels
Full worksheet workflow has no JavaScript errors, CSP violations or external runtime requests
